field_scope: Uses the unchanged canonical momentum-angle roof field. Adds all-contact first-derivative decay at every regular trajectory and uniform full-guard variation along survivors, without incidence cutoffs. Exit localization includes incidence, first-hit clearance and all section tests. Survival across true boundaries is not inferred.
recoupling_scope: The maximal coupling preserves one fixed exact label and the physical endpoint-momentum angle. It may pair different actual words. Its defect is at most the forward stopped-flow defect for the specified field, not asserted smaller than every two-sided scalar or arbitrary-field modulus.
current_scope: The regular internal-section current is an exact occupation difference on every compact regular domain. Initial/terminal boundaries and grazing/first-hit transitions remain separate. No uniform surface-current primitive bound or isolated-component exhaustion convergence is claimed. Every nonzero spectral-peak leading factor is retained.
limit_order: Fix B, epsilon(B), r(B), and all auxiliary bands before collision limsup; enlarge auxiliary band afterwards, and B last. No collision-dependent Fourier band, guard alteration, label pooling or zero-class normalization.
qualification_scope: Exact-SHA preservation, finite normal/optimized fixtures, full native journal and 176-core supplement, actual 179-core union recorder coverage, stable warning-free references and page geometry. These checks are not mathematical certification.
new_complete_estimate: The full guard-distortion contribution is bounded by C epsilon^{-1} sqrt(r) after averaging translated target fibers and taking the ordered m^2 collision norm. Only fixed-width unweighted concentration is used. The residual complete true-exit and optical-volume defect is not proved small.
validation_scope: Finite rational/algebraic fixtures, source preservation, normal/optimized agreement, native TeX builds, recorder coverage and PDF geometry. These checks are not a continuum proof certificate or an independent specialist review.
